name: Playground
tagline: A bright, hands-on playground starring Wally the walrus: pick a trigger and an action, then watch a phone, a flow diagram and the real open-wa code play the combo out.
logo: A sunny speech bubble that is also Wally's face (round spectacles, cream muzzle, two tusks); on hover or focus it wiggles on a spring, blinks and flexes its tusks, and it blinks now and then on its own.
